start.hint: 状态流填写实际状态名；节点流仅列出当前账号负责且进行中的节点，动作名例如「完成节点「开发」」，通常配置在提交验收时。状态无通用分类，无法保证不倒退。

en.hint: Use actual state names for state flows. Node flows offer only active nodes owned by the current account; configure completion on review. Status categories are unavailable, so backward moves cannot be detected.

settings.label: 空间地址
settings.hint: 在空间里打开任意页面，复制浏览器地址栏的地址。飞书项目和 Meegle（Lark）都支持，按域名区分。修改后需要重新登录。

en.label: Space URL
en.hint: Open any page in the space and copy the address. Works for both Feishu Project and Meegle (Lark). Changing it signs you out.

settings.label: 同步类型
settings.hint: 默认同步需求（story）和缺陷（issue），一般无需修改。自定义类型可填写类型 key，用逗号分隔；同步后会出现在回写规则中。

en.label: Types to sync
en.hint: Defaults to stories (story) and defects (issue). For custom types, enter comma-separated type keys; discovered types appear in writeback rules.

settings.label: 筛选条件（MQL）
settings.hint: 默认同步当前由我负责的工作项；已有筛选条件会保留。可填写 WHERE 后面的 MQL 条件，例如我参与的：array_contains(all_participate_persons(), current_login_user())。

en.label: Filter (MQL)
en.hint: Defaults to items currently assigned to you; existing filters are preserved. Enter the MQL condition after WHERE; all participation: array_contains(all_participate_persons(), current_login_user()).
